description: Telephone and Internet Services by Type and Year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents annual statistics on telecommunications services in the State of Qatar for the period. It includes data on the number of fixed telephone lines, the number of normal GSM mobile subscribers, and Hala prepaid mobile subscribers. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are telecommunications, mobile, GSM, Fixedline, qatar. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
